{{Quote|This place is dangerous, in case you hadn't noticed.|[[Saché/Legends|Saché]]|<ref name="SWG:S">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Saché|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Mauler Stronghold''' was the base of operations for the [[Maulers]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It consisted of a small Nabooian villa and a bunker facility, located near the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]].<ref name="SWG:MS" /> The area used to be inhabited by peaceful [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] philosophers but it turned to smoking ruins after the Maulers occupied the place.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> Mauler [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] trained [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]] for fighting and had enclosures in the Stronghold.<ref name="SWG:MS" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Mauler Stronghold is a difficult place to get into, but I need somone to sabotage their weapons cache.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TSI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Stronghold Infiltration|Naboo}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> The [[Royal Security Police Force]] [[Royal Security Forces police raid on Mauler base|raided]] the Mauler Stronghold and killed the Mauler leader known as the [[Mauler Usurper]].<ref name="SWG:TPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Police Work|Naboo}}</ref> Around the same time, the Stronghold was also [[Royal Security Forces marines raid on Mauler base|targeted]] by the [[Royal Marine Regiment]]. Weapons caches were confiscated<ref name="SWG:TSI" /> and four Mauler leaders were eliminated: the chief tactician [[Zolo Sartain]], the [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]] [[Yarick Tempol]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Xylan Kee'choap]] and the mystic [[Walus Mutin]]<ref name="SWG:TSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Stronghold Elimination|Naboo}}</ref>

Later, a spacer sent by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] entered the Mauler Stronghold to retrieve one of the pieces of a broken [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact scattered by the [[Ultragungans]] in various areas of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover all Six Pieces of the scattered Gungan Artifact|Naboo}}</ref>

The same year, the Maulers raided the [[Corellian Security Force]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] henchman [[Bruce McBrain]] later dispatched a spacer to the Mauler Stronghold in order to retrieve the destruction code sequences of a CorSec [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]] possibly stolen by the Maulers.<ref name="SWG:BM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bruce McBrain"</ref>
